reason: B is the better, though still weak, proposal because it tests a distinct dwell-induced homogenization mechanism against a rapid-quench baseline, whereas A essentially repeats the exact 1100 K/5 min disorder-to-order experiment already reported and also moves outside the targeted disordered solid-solution state into an ordered intermetallic. B remains underspecified and its evidence suggests rapid quenching can already produce homogeneous alloys, so its diffusion-based prediction requires careful testing.
